# Synthetic notes compatibility project

This project contains invented text only. It is a proposed compatibility fixture
for the selected notes agent; it contains no copies of the owner's notes, agent
configuration, credentials, conversation histories or summaries.

The owner must approve staging and execution before it is used on the dedicated
test VM. A read-only pass may summarize `meeting.txt`. A separately approved
write pass may create `summary.txt` here. Result attachments belong in the
executor's separate `/task-outputs` mount.

Creating this fixture does not supply a provider runtime, model, image,
authentication method, network capability or execution approval.
